tickerText: [TENNIS] Post-Wimbledon clay swing rolls on at Bastad, Gstaad and Umag — Stefanos Tsitsipas snapped a five-match skid vs Top 50 foes with a 6-4, 6-4 win over fifth seed Ignacio Buse in Gstaad, while Stan Wawrinka bowed out in his 14th and final Swiss Open appearance — at the WTA Athens Open, Maria Sakkari faces Harriet Dart in Wednesday's featured Centre Court clash • [SQUASH] HCL Chennai PSA Challenger finals day: Joachim Chuah and Adham Roshdy meet for the men's title after five-set and straight-set semifinal wins — top seed Rouqaia Othman takes on Korea's Hwayeong Eum in the women's final after sweeping India's Sanya Vats 11-4, 11-2, 11-5 on Tuesday • [BADMINTON] Japan Open Super 750 Day 2 in Tokyo: defending champion Shi Yuqi cruised past Japan's Yudai Okimoto in straight games, Olympic champion An Se-young dismantled Hina Akechi 21-6, 21-9, and PV Sindhu advanced 21-14, 21-11 — Satwik-Chirag retired hurt in their men's doubles opener • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Australia 250 Melbourne opens today at Raya Pickleball Club through July 19, ahead of the Macon PPA Challenger July 17–19 and the sold-out Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore July 23–26 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar Day 2: U13 and U17 singles continue at Mongolia's first ITTF world-ranking events with 300-plus athletes from 30 nations — the WTT Feeder follows July 19–23

newsItems.title: Tsitsipas Beats Buse to Snap Top-50 Losing Streak in Gstaad
newsItems.excerpt: Stefanos Tsitsipas defeated fifth seed Ignacio Buse 6-4, 6-4 in the EFG Swiss Open Gstaad opening round, ending a five-match losing streak against Top 50 opponents and avenging his Mallorca grass loss. The Greek next faces Swiss wild card Jerome Kym as the post-Wimbledon clay swing continues alongside Bastad and Umag.

newsItems.title: Shi Yuqi and An Se-young Cruise Through Japan Open Day 2
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Shi Yuqi beat Japan's Yudai Okimoto in straight games at the DAIHATSU Japan Open Super 750 in Tokyo on Wednesday, while Olympic champion An Se-young dismissed Hina Akechi 21-6, 21-9 in 32 minutes. PV Sindhu also advanced 21-14, 21-11, though Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty retired hurt in men's doubles.

newsItems.title: PPA Australia 250 Melbourne Gets Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne begins today at Raya Pickleball Club, running through July 19 as the first stop in a busy stretch that includes the Macon PPA Challenger and the inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore. The Singapore event has sold out weekend sessions with 150-plus pros from 13 countries entered.

newsItems.title: WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar Enters Day Two
newsItems.excerpt: U13 and U17 singles continue on Day 2 of the WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar 2026 at the Buyant-Ukhaa Sports Complex, part of Mongolia's first ITTF world-ranking tournaments with 300-plus athletes from 30 countries. A WTT Feeder event follows July 19–23 at the same venue.
